The sum of all integers from 1 to 1000 that are divisible by both 3 and 7 is **23,688**. 

This is calculated by finding the least common multiple (LCM) of 3 and 7, which is 21. Then, summing the arithmetic sequence of multiples of 21 up to 987 (the largest multiple of 21 ≤ 1000) using the formula:  
$$
\text{Sum} = \frac{n}{2} \times (\text{first term} + \text{last term}) = \frac{47}{2} \times (21 + 987) = 23,688.
$$
